answer:
Done — I made the “Guest wifi” note into an App-side Wi‑Fi QR code display.

- It reads the network name/password/security from the note text.
- Shows a large scan-ready QR code for joining the guest network.
- Includes the network name and manual-join hint.
- Works in light/dark mode and phone/Mac layouts.
- I ran the app checker and it passes with no issues.

The note’s text was left unchanged.
